sentences.s: "There is one and only one social responsibility of business,"

trunk.宾语或表语: one and only one social responsibility of business
trunk.主干翻译: （企业）有且只有一种社会责任。

sentences.zh: “企业有且只有一种社会责任，”

sentences.s: Wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel Prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits."

trunk.主干翻译: 米尔顿·弗里德曼写道（如下内容）。

components.原文: a Nobel Prize-winning economist
components.中文翻译: 一位诺贝尔奖得主经济学家
components.说明: 对Milton Friedman的同位说明（插入）

components.原文: That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits
components.中文翻译: 那就是，运用其资源、从事旨在增加其利润的活动

components.原文: engage in activities designed to increase its profits
components.中文翻译: 从事旨在增加其利润的活动
components.说明: 与to use并列的不定式动作

components.原文: designed to increase its profits
components.中文翻译: 旨在增加其利润的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作定语修饰activities

components.原文: to increase its profits
components.中文翻译: 以增加其利润

sentences.zh: 诺贝尔奖得主经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼写道，“那就是，运用其资源、从事旨在增加其利润的活动。”

sentences.s: But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.

trunk.主干翻译: 事情未必绝对一目了然。

components.原文: even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money
components.中文翻译: 即便你接受弗里德曼的前提，并把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为对股东金钱的浪费
components.说明: even if引导让步状语从句

components.原文: regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money
components.中文翻译: 把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为对股东金钱的浪费

sentences.zh: 但即便你接受弗里德曼的前提，并把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为对股东金钱的浪费，事情也未必绝对一目了然。

sentences.s: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies—at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.

components.原文: that CSR may create monetary value for companies—at least when they are prosecuted for corruption
components.中文翻译: CSR可能为公司创造货币价值——至少在它们因腐败而被起诉时如此

components.原文: when they are prosecuted for corruption
components.中文翻译: 当它们因腐败而被起诉时
components.说明: when引导时间状语从句，修饰create

sentences.zh: 新研究表明，CSR可能为公司创造货币价值——至少在它们因腐败而被起诉时如此。

sentences.s: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.

trunk.主语: The largest firms in America and Britain
trunk.宾语或表语: more than $15 billion a year on CSR
trunk.主干翻译: 美国和英国最大的公司每年共在CSR上花费超过150亿美元。

components.原文: a consulting firm
components.中文翻译: 一家咨询公司

components.原文: according to an estimate by EPG
components.中文翻译: 据咨询公司EPG的一项估计
components.说明: according to短语作状语，表来源

sentences.zh: 据咨询公司EPG的一项估计，美国和英国最大的公司每年共在CSR上花费超过150亿美元。

sentences.s: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.

trunk.宾语或表语: value to their businesses in three ways
trunk.主干翻译: 这可以通过三种方式为它们的业务增加价值。

sentences.zh: 这可以通过三种方式为它们的业务增加价值。

sentences.s: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a "signal" that a company's products are of high quality.

trunk.主干翻译: 消费者可能把CSR支出视为一种“信号”。

components.原文: that a company's products are of high quality
components.中文翻译: 某公司的产品是高品质的
components.说明: that引导同位语从句，说明signal的内容

sentences.zh: 首先，消费者可能把CSR支出视为某公司产品高品质的一种“信号”。

sentences.s: Second, customers may be willing to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps.

trunk.主干翻译: 顾客可能愿意购买某公司的产品。

components.原文: to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps
components.中文翻译: 购买某公司的产品，作为向其所支持的公益事业捐款的一种间接方式

components.原文: to donate to the good causes it helps
components.中文翻译: 向其所支持的公益事业捐款
components.说明: 不定式作定语/状语表目的，说明间接方式的用途

components.原文: it helps
components.中文翻译: 它所支持的
components.说明: 省略关系词的定语从句修饰good causes

sentences.zh: 其次，顾客可能愿意购买某公司的产品，以此作为向该公司所支持的公益事业捐款的一种间接方式。

sentences.s: And third, through a more diffuse "halo effect" whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.

trunk.主干翻译: （第三，这可以）通过一种更弥散的“光环效应”（增加价值）。

components.原文: whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others
components.中文翻译: 凭借这种效应，公司的善举为其赢得消费者及他人的更多体谅
components.说明: whereby引导定语从句修饰halo effect

sentences.zh: 第三，是通过一种更为弥散的“光环效应”，借此公司的善举为其赢得消费者及他人的更多体谅。

sentences.s: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three.

trunk.主干翻译: 以往关于CSR的研究在区分这些效应方面遇到了困难。

components.原文: differentiating these effects
components.中文翻译: 区分这些效应（方面的）

components.原文: because consumers can be affected by all three
components.中文翻译: 因为消费者可能同时受这三者影响

sentences.zh: 以往关于CSR的研究难以区分这些效应，因为消费者可能同时受到这三者的影响。

sentences.s: A recent study attempts to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under American's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).

trunk.主干翻译: 近期一项研究试图把它们区分开。

components.原文: to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under American's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA)
components.中文翻译: 通过考察依据美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）提起的贿赂诉讼来区分它们

components.原文: by looking at bribery prosecutions under American's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA)
components.中文翻译: 通过考察依据美国《反海外腐败法》提起的贿赂诉讼

components.原文: FCPA
components.中文翻译: 即FCPA
components.说明: 对Foreign Corrupt Practices Act的缩写同位说明

sentences.zh: 近期一项研究试图通过考察依据美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）提起的贿赂诉讼，来把这些效应区分开。

sentences.s: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect.

components.原文: that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect
components.中文翻译: 既然检察官在调查中不会消费公司的产品，他们就只可能受到光环效应的影响

components.原文: since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations
components.中文翻译: 既然检察官在调查中不会消费公司的产品

sentences.zh: 该研究认为，既然检察官在调查过程中不会消费公司的产品，那么他们就只可能受到光环效应的影响。

sentences.s: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.

components.原文: that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties
components.中文翻译: 在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面CSR项目的公司往往会受到较轻的处罚

components.原文: to get more lenient penalties
components.中文翻译: 受到较轻的处罚

components.原文: among prosecuted firms
components.中文翻译: 在被起诉的公司中

sentences.zh: 该研究发现，在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面CSR项目的公司往往会受到较轻的处罚。

sentences.s: Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firm's political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.

trunk.主干翻译: 他们的分析排除了这种可能性。

components.原文: that it was firm's political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency
components.中文翻译: 是公司的政治影响力、而非其CSR立场，才是宽大处理的原因
components.说明: that引导同位语从句，说明possibility内容；内部含强调句式

components.原文: it was firm's political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency
components.中文翻译: 正是公司的政治影响力（而非其CSR立场）才是宽大处理的原因
components.说明: it was ... that ... 强调句，强调主语

components.原文: their CSR stand
components.中文翻译: 它们的CSR立场
components.说明: rather than连接，与political influence并列对照

components.原文: that contributed more to political campaigns
components.中文翻译: 对政治竞选捐款更多的

sentences.zh: 他们的分析排除了这样一种可能性：即真正导致宽大处理的是公司的政治影响力、而非其CSR立场——那些对政治竞选捐款更多的公司并未获得更低的罚款。

sentences.s: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.

trunk.主干翻译: 该研究得出结论（某情况）。

components.原文: that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR
components.中文翻译: 尽管检察官本应只根据案件本身的是非曲直来评判案件，但他们似乎确实会受到公司CSR记录的影响

components.原文: whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits
components.中文翻译: 尽管检察官本应只根据案件本身的是非曲直来评判案件

components.原文: to be influenced by a company's record in CSR
components.中文翻译: 受到公司CSR记录的影响

sentences.zh: 总之，该研究得出结论：尽管检察官本应只依据案件本身的是非曲直来评判案件，但他们似乎确实会受到公司CSR记录的影响。

sentences.s: "We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.

trunk.主干翻译: 一位研究者说道（如下内容）。

components.原文: We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials
components.中文翻译: 我们估计，无论是消除某项重大劳工权益问题（如童工），还是把企业捐赠增加约20%，所导致的罚款通常都比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%

components.原文: that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials
components.中文翻译: 无论是消除某项重大劳工权益问题（如童工），还是把企业捐赠增加约20%，所导致的罚款通常都比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%

components.原文: increasing corporate giving by about 20%
components.中文翻译: 把企业捐赠增加约20%
components.说明: either...or...连接两个并列主语动名词

components.原文: that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials
components.中文翻译: 通常比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%的

sentences.zh: 一位研究者说：“我们估计，无论是消除某项重大劳工权益问题（如使用童工），还是把企业捐赠增加约20%，所带来的罚款通常都比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%。”

sentences.s: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.

components.原文: that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR
components.中文翻译: 他们的研究并未回答企业应该在CSR上花费多少这一问题

components.原文: how much businesses ought to spend on CSR
components.中文翻译: 企业应该在CSR上花费多少
components.说明: how much引导的从句作question的同位/宾语，说明其内容

sentences.zh: 研究者们承认，他们的研究并未回答企业究竟应该在CSR上花费多少这一问题。

sentences.s: Nor does it reveal how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies.

components.原文: Nor does it reveal
components.中文翻译: 它也没有揭示
components.说明: Nor置于句首引起部分倒装

components.原文: how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies
components.中文翻译: 公司在决定其行善政策时，在多大程度上指望的是光环效应、而非其他可能的好处

components.原文: the other possible benefits
components.中文翻译: 其他可能的好处
components.说明: rather than连接，与the halo effect并列对照

components.原文: when they decide their do-gooding policies
components.中文翻译: 当它们决定其行善政策时

sentences.zh: 它也没有揭示，公司在决定其行善政策时，究竟在多大程度上指望的是光环效应、而非其他可能的好处。

sentences.s: But at least they have demonstrated that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment.

trunk.主干翻译: 他们至少已经证明了（某情况）。

components.原文: that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment
components.中文翻译: 当公司触犯法律陷入麻烦时，良好品行的证据能为它们赢得较轻的处罚

components.原文: when companies get into trouble with the law
components.中文翻译: 当公司触犯法律陷入麻烦时

sentences.zh: 但他们至少已经证明：当公司触犯法律陷入麻烦时，良好品行的证据能为它们赢得较轻的处罚。
